message:
I just deleted a stupid and hostile comment  from a mouth-breather with the IP address 208.241.6.12. Guess where that IP is? Irving, Texas; home of T-Netix / Securus operations -- and from the sense of entitlement the mouth-breather displayed, I wouldn't be surprised if it was someone with a management background. So I've banned the IP, and I encourage readers here to check out the management team at [http://www.t-netix.com/staff_default.asp](http://www.t-netix.com/staff_default.asp) (the information there might be useful in conjunction with the information at [http://www.anywho.com](http://www.anywho.com)) and do whatever you think is appropriate. The commenter's advice, by the way, was repeated twice: "Stop crying already."

The area code for the Dallas/Irving area is 972.
